comment: The shape control is a closed ring rather than a span with ends: sweeping past stepped random comes back round to sine, which is what lets a shape CV or a link offset wrap instead of stopping at an edge. The staircase and stepped random shapes take their step count from the bar division unless a cable is in the clock jack, in which case each pulse is one step.
